D 6777
18 / 6 / 35

June 18 35.

Mrs. Edith Gleeson,
165 Berkley St.,
Carlton, N.3,
Melbourne,
Australia.

Madam,

With reference to your letter dated May 14,
I have to state that your letter has been shown to
Mr. R.D. Parkin who states that he would communicate
with you in due course.

I am, Madam,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)
for Commissioner of Police.

D 6777
1935年6月18日

1935年6月18日。

伊迪丝·格里森夫人，
澳大利亚，
墨尔本，
卡尔顿区 N.3，
伯克利街 165 号。

夫人：

关于您5月14日的来信，本人谨此告知，该信已呈阅 R.D. Parkin 先生，他表示将在适当时候与您联系。

此致
敬礼

警务处副处长（特别支部）
代警务处长

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE B. REGISTRY.
Special Branch S.2. Station 6227
REPORT
Date June 17th / 8. 10. 35. / 35
Subject Letter from Mrs. Edith Gleeson of 165, Berkley St., Carlton N. 3,
Melbourne, Australia, on the subject of her dead sister's son, Douglas Reg Parkin.
Made by D.P.S. Duke Forwarded by [签名] 9.9

Mrs. Gleeson's letter has been shown confidentially to
Mr. R.D. Parkin, who is now employed in C.E. Spark's Insurance
office, 322 Kiangse Rd., and he stated that the writer was his
aunt and that she had on a previous occasion attempted to get
into touch with him through the Municipal Council, by whom he was
then employed.
Mr. Parkin said that he would appreciate if the Police,
in their reply, would content themselves with informing Mrs.
Gleeson that her nephew had been shown her letter and that he
would communicate with her himself.

[签名]
D.P.S.
D.C. ( Special Branch ).

Mr Yao,
Please prepare draft.
[签名]
18 JUNE 1935

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号：警务处 B 类登记处。
特别支部 S.2. 第 6227 号分站
报告
日期：1935年6月17日 / 8. 10. 35. / 35
事由：澳大利亚墨尔本卡尔顿区 N.3 伯克利街 165 号伊迪丝·格里森夫人来函，事关其亡妹之子道格拉斯·雷格·帕金（Douglas Reg Parkin）。
制作人：D.P.S. Duke 转交人：[签名] 9.9

格里森夫人的来信已机密地出示给 R.D. Parkin 先生，他目前受雇于江西路 322 号 C.E. Spark 保险公司办公室。他表示，去信人是他的姑母，她此前曾试图通过当时雇用他的工部局与他取得联系。
帕金先生表示，如果警方在回信中仅告知格里森夫人，她的侄子已阅悉其来信，并将亲自与她联系，他将不胜感激。

[签名]
D.P.S.
副处长（特别支部）。

姚先生，
请拟草稿。
[签名]
1935年6月18日
